## Activation functions

The activation function decides how strong a neuron's output is. A
rectified linear unit (ReLU) passes positive values unchanged and turns
negative values into zero.

::widget{ref="w1" primitive_hint="three-frame" mode_hint="predict"}

The sigmoid squeezes the output into a bounded range between zero and
one. A network with only linear layers is still one linear transformation.

::quiz{ref="q1"}

directives.intent: Ask the reader to predict the output of a ReLU for a negative input.
Check that the reader knows why a non-linear activation is needed.
